profile_count_dictionary_marginalization.procedure: Construct the exact 1,856-row eight-variable profile-count dictionary from the governed same-unit facts; for each of all 255 nonempty variable subsets, marginalize full-profile counts to the subset and compare against a direct respondent-level subset enumeration.

nongeneralization: This independently validates the bounded FFIF012F finite-state discovery facts only. It does not establish that every source/surface admits the same finite profile representation or that all future discovery/follow-up claims require no richer object.
